notes.title: Playtest Update Apr 9th
notes.content:
[b]Changes seen in the playtest[/b]
- Explosive weapons deal proper AOE damage and have larger visual effects to reflect the radius of the AOE. 
- Explosions now apply force to nearby objects.
- Certain tether weapons now apply force to nearby objects when they collide with a surface at high speed.
- Minor level design updates for improved clarity.
- Various bug fixes.

[b]Other changes[/b]
- The second level and the rest of FUZZ's core systems and mechanics are progressing.

notes.title: Jan 24th Hotfix
notes.content:
UPDATES
- Bugfixes
- Fuzz now drops his acorn top on death, which can be picked up and used as a projectile.

notes.title: Playtest 6: Tether and Combat
notes.content:
1. Extended playtest level.
2. Added "Tree Carver Warrior" enemy type.
3. Added "Health Pickups" to restore player health.
4. Coals can now be picked up and used as a projectile.
5. Improved the elemental pickup system (fire removes your water and all pickups are incremental).
6. Added the "Send Feedback" option to the menu.
7. Added the "Report Bugs" option to the menu.
